note: Shade's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md): the nomad kit's materials (NOMAD.MAT, 77a-kit-nomad-core.js) take a library colour map in place (src/78b-host-matlib.js); they are Lambert, so mapOnly. Grey maps (keep 0) normalised to the base brightness of the procedural map each replaces, so the vertex-colour tints keep their tone. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py settlements/shade after any change, then python3 build.py; ?mat=proc shows the procedural look.
